SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

executeBuyFist().details: Price policy: "how much FIST is 1 OSK worth" (rFist/rOsk). Requirement L63 text: "buy 5% when the price drops 10% ... a single buy is worth at most 1000 usd,   if one buy does not meet the target then buy in multiple batches, and once met stop supporting the market that day" --   so the buy side is a **batched** mechanism: a single buy <= 1000 USD value, and if the target is not met it can be called again the same day;   once the price returns to the -5% target, todayBuyFistFinished is set and no more buying happens that day. Pitfall (severe): `todayBuyFistFinished` must be **reset on a new day** (handled by `_resetBuyFistDay()`) --   if it is only set true and never reset, then after the first target is met the flag stays true forever and the buy side is permanently crippled. Pitfall: the new-day check must come **before** the `todayBuyFistFinished` guard, otherwise the reset can never happen. Pitfall: CEI -- record the day's cumulative amount first, then perform the external swap interaction.

executeSellFist().details: Target: push back down to ref + 3% (SELL_TARGET_RISE_BP). Pitfall: once per cycle -- a second call in the same cycle reverts (cycle = PERIOD_SECONDS: production 1 day / FAST_TEST 1 hour).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setMaxRefDeviationBp(uint256).details: 0 disables clamping (not recommended). The upper bound is BP (10000) = 100%.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

PERIOD_SECONDS.details: Market-making cycle length (seconds) -- the cycle basis for reference price locking and "sell once a day".      Production = **1 day**; when `GlobalConfig.FAST_TEST = true` it shortens to **1 hour**,      so that "support the market successfully once a day" can be reproduced within 1 hour in fast tests.      Evidence: the client requested on 2026-09-26 "change the insurance pool's once-a-day successful market support to once an hour". Pitfall: unrelated to `Treasury.REFILL_COOLDOWN` -- the latter is the treasury refill cooldown, and the two are independent.

maxRefDeviationBp.details: The reference price snapshot's **single-period maximum deviation** (bp). Prevents manipulating the spot reserves at a cycle boundary to lock in a distorted reference price.      Default 2000 (20%). Setting it to 0 disables clamping (not recommended).

executeBuyFist().notice: FIST market support buy: when OSK depreciates >=10% against FIST, use the FIST reserve to buy OSK

executeSellFist().notice: FIST market support sell: when OSK appreciates >=10% against FIST, sell OSK back for FIST

setBToken(address).notice: Set the FIST token address (market-making payment token)

setOskFistPair(address).notice: Set the OSK/FIST pair (market support target)

updateDailyReferenceFist().notice: Refresh the FIST channel's intraday reference price (public keeper entry point)

setMaxRefDeviationBp(uint256).notice: Set the FIST reference price's single-period maximum deviation (bp)

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

executeBuyFist().details: Price policy: "how much FIST is 1 OSK worth" (rFist/rOsk). Requirement L63 text: "buy 5% when the price drops 10% ... a single buy is worth at most 1000 usd,   if one buy does not meet the target then buy in multiple batches, and once met stop supporting the market that day" --   so the buy side is a **batched** mechanism: a single buy <= 1000 USD value, and if the target is not met it can be called again the same day;   once the price returns to the -5% target, todayBuyFistFinished is set and no more buying happens that day. Pitfall (severe): `todayBuyFistFinished` must be **reset on a new day** (handled by `_resetBuyFistDay()`) --   if it is only set true and never reset, then after the first target is met the flag stays true forever and the buy side is permanently crippled. Pitfall: the new-day check must come **before** the `todayBuyFistFinished` guard, otherwise the reset can never happen. Pitfall: CEI -- record the day's cumulative amount first, then perform the external swap interaction.

executeSellFist().details: Target: push back down to ref + 3% (SELL_TARGET_RISE_BP). Pitfall: once per cycle -- a second call in the same cycle reverts (cycle = PERIOD_SECONDS: production 1 day / FAST_TEST 1 hour).

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

setMaxRefDeviationBp(uint256).details: 0 disables clamping (not recommended). The upper bound is BP (10000) = 100%.

PERIOD_SECONDS.details: Market-making cycle length (seconds) -- the cycle basis for reference price locking and "sell once a day".      Production = **1 day**; when `GlobalConfig.FAST_TEST = true` it shortens to **1 hour**,      so that "support the market successfully once a day" can be reproduced within 1 hour in fast tests.      Evidence: the client requested on 2026-09-26 "change the insurance pool's once-a-day successful market support to once an hour". Pitfall: unrelated to `Treasury.REFILL_COOLDOWN` -- the latter is the treasury refill cooldown, and the two are independent.

maxRefDeviationBp.details: The reference price snapshot's **single-period maximum deviation** (bp). Prevents manipulating the spot reserves at a cycle boundary to lock in a distorted reference price.      Default 2000 (20%). Setting it to 0 disables clamping (not recommended).
